source(output(
		InvoiceNumber as string,
		CustomerNumber as string,
		InvoiceDate as date,
		PurchaseOrderNumber as string,
		AmountDue as integer,
		InvoiceCreatedDate as date,
		PDFFileName as string,
		InvoicedAmount as integer,
		CustomerPayment as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::QueryReadFromSourcecsvAG',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ReadfromStgEcomInvoice
ReadfromStgEcomInvoice derive() ~> ReadfromStgEcomInvoiceErrorReformat
ReadfromStgEcomInvoice derive(InvoiceDateStr = toString(InvoiceDate),
		AmountDueStr = toString(AmountDue),
		InvoicedAmountStr = toString(InvoicedAmount),
		CustomerPaymentStr = toString((iif(isNull(CustomerPayment), '0.00', toString(CustomerPayment))))) ~> DerivedColumn
ReadfromStgEcomInvoice aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowsReadNoErrorAGGREGATE
ReadfromStgEcomInvoiceErrorReformat derive() ~> ReadfromStgEcomInvoice0
ReadfromStgEcomInvoiceErrorReformat derive(ErrorCode = ErrorCode) ~> PlaceHolderGetErrorDescErrorColumn
ReadfromStgEcomInvoiceErrorReformat aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowsReadErrorAGGREGATE
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		AmountDue as string,
		PurchaseOrderNumber as string,
		CustomerNumber as string,
		CustomerPayment as string,
		InvoiceCreatedDate as string,
		PDFFileName as string,
		InvoiceNumber as string,
		InvoiceDate as string,
		InvoicedAmount as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AmountDue = AmountDueStr,
		PurchaseOrderNumber,
		CustomerNumber,
		CustomerPayment = CustomerPaymentStr,
		InvoiceCreatedDate,
		PDFFileName,
		InvoiceNumber,
		InvoiceDate = InvoiceDateStr,
		InvoicedAmount = InvoicedAmountStr)) ~> WritetoInvoiceFile
RowsReadNoErrorAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowsReadNoErrorCACHESINK
ReadfromStgEcomInvoice0 sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn()) ~> ReadfromStgEcomInvoiceERROROUTPUTFILE
PlaceHolderGetErrorDescErrorColumn derive(PackageGuid = $packageID,
		PackageName = toString($packageName),
		TaskName = toString($taskName),
		ErrorType = toString('Error'),
		ErrorDatetime = notConvertedectfunctiondategetdatef(),
		ErrorSource = toString(notConvertedectfunctionstringtoken(ErrorColumnName, '.', 1)),
		ETLCreateDate = $startTime,
		ETLExecutionID = PackageExecutionID,
		ErrorRecordId = toString(InvoiceNumber),
		ErrorColumnName = toString(notConvertedectfunctionstringtoken(ErrorColumnName, '.', 3))) ~> DeriveErrorInfo
RowsReadErrorAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowsReadErrorCACHESINK
DeriveErrorInfo sink(input(
		ETLCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ErrorDescription as string,
		ErrorColumn as string,
		ErrorSource as string,
		ErrorType as string,
		PackageName as string,
		TaskName as string,
		ETLExecutionID as long,
		ErrorRecordId as string,
		ErrorDatetime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PackageGuid as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ETLCreateDate,
		ErrorDescription,
		ErrorColumn = ErrorColumnName,
		ErrorSource,
		ErrorType,
		PackageName,
		TaskName,
		ETLExecutionID,
		ErrorRecordId,
		ErrorDatetime,
		PackageGuid)) ~> WritetoError
